author: Baron Godfrey Rathbone Benson Charnwood
claims: Abraham Lincoln was carried still unconscious to a house near the theatre on the night of Good Friday.
His sons and other friends were summoned.
A look of unspeakable peace came over his worn features.
At 7.22 on the morning of April 15, Stanton announced that Lincoln had passed away.
Stanton's words were: "Now he belongs to the ages."
